notes: The posted list totals 60. Below it the author wrote 'DAMN IT I FORGOT THE GRABBER, THERE IS NO TRY AND OPPRESSIVE ENFORCEMENT / TAKE OUT THE AVENGER, DEATH STAR, AND POINT MAN.' His correction is applied: the three forgotten cards are added and Avenger, Death Star and Point Man are left out (total 60).
The 'Grabber' is shown as posted (UNKNOWN): no Dark 'grabber' card can be matched with confidence in May 2000. There Is No Try and Oppressive Enforcement are the Dagobah / Special Edition Effects.
The strategy says 'Start with whatever effect you deem necessary', so no starting Effect is set.

Posted 'Raltiir' dested Ralltiir; 'Kashyyk' Kashyyyk; 'EPP Vader' Darth Vader With Lightsaber; 'Bossk In Bus' Bossk In Hound's Tooth; 'DSSD' Death Squadron Star Destroyer; 'Abyssin Ornament' is the Jabba's Palace interrupt (not a (V) card); '3,720 To 1' the Dagobah Effect. Battle Order is the Endor Effect (no Defensive Shields in 2000).

The description credits the design to Eric Berger ('I took his design and crafted my own style of deck out of it'); the strategy says Berger played something similar at the Texas States and went undefeated. This is Warren's own list, filed as general.
